fda.text: Phenoxybenzamine hydrochloride-induced alpha -adrenergic blockade leaves beta -adrenergic receptors unopposed. Compounds that stimulate both types of receptors may, therefore, produce an exaggerated hypotensive response and tachycardia.

examples.title: Use of Phenoxybenzamine [PBZ] IV to Assist High Flow Low Pressure Perfusion [HFLPP] on Cardio-pulmonary Bypass
examples.why: New protocol now being used for cardiopulmonary bypass

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, calculated a low risk score for the liver and a high risk score for the heart [M]. Drugs that are chemically similar to Phenoxybenzamine Hydrochloride have faced severe issues, such as being pulled from the market in the United Kingdom for liver damage or carrying boxed warnings in the United States for heart injury [3][4]. Additionally, the official drug label warns that it can interact with certain substances to trigger an exaggerated drop in blood pressure and an abnormally fast heartbeat [5].
